From missile launches and military provocations to propaganda loudspeakers, fake villages, trash-filled balloons, and enormous flagpoles, North Korea has developed some bizarre ways to intimidate South Korea and the West. Discover the strange mixture of genuine threats, psychological warfare, propaganda, and petty rivalry used by the secretive state.
